title: MUSE: Multi-Task Uncertainty-Aware Self-Supervised Encoder for mmWave ISAC
abstract: arXiv:2611.34122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) allows a wireless system to use the same waveform for communication and environment sensing. At mmWave frequency bands, ISAC enables diverse human sensing tasks, such as localization, gesture recognition, and pose estimation, with high precision. However, each task requires training a dedicated model, typically from scratch on a task-specific dataset, with no mechanism to flag unreliable predictions. This hurts the scalability, transferability, and reliability of mmWave ISAC models. In this work, we propose MUSE (Multi-task Uncertainty-aware Self-supervised Encoder), a unified framework for mmWave human sensing. MUSE leverages a self-supervised transformer model with per-dataset tokenization and is trained via masked autoencoding across five datasets. translated_title: MUSE：面向毫米波ISAC的多任务不确定性感知自监督编码器
translated_abstract: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）使无线系统能够使用相同的波形同时进行通信和环境感知。在毫米波频段，ISAC能够以高精度实现多样化的人体感知任务，例如定位、手势识别和姿态估计。然而，每个任务都需要训练一个专用模型，通常需要在任务特定的数据集上从头开始训练，且缺乏标记不可靠预测的机制。这损害了毫米波ISAC模型的可扩展性、可迁移性和可靠性。在本工作中，我们提出了MUSE（多任务不确定性感知自监督编码器），这是一个用于毫米波人体感知的统一框架。MUSE利用带有逐数据集标记化的自监督transformer模型，并通过掩码自编码在五个数据集上进行训练。在微调过程中，MUSE使用证据分类头来实现不确定性量化。MUSE用单个统一编码器取代了N个独立编码器。
tldr: 提出MUSE统一框架，通过自监督transformer与掩码自编码在多个数据集上预训练，并利用证据分类头实现不确定性量化，以单一编码器取代针对各任务单独训练的多个模型，提升了毫米波人体感知的可扩展性、可迁移性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: MUSE is a unified framework for mmWave human sensing that pre-trains a self-supervised transformer via masked autoencoding across five datasets and employs evidential classification heads for uncertainty quantification, replacing multiple task-specific encoders with a single one.
